units.source_text: 倘若我按照叔叔的要求，和他的女儿结婚的话，在物质方面会对我有利吧，这是不言而喻的。

en.t: If I had followed my uncle's wishes and married his daughter, it goes without saying that it would probably have benefited me materially.

units.source_text: 叔叔是存心要把女儿强加给我的，他向我提出婚姻问题，不是为了两家的交好互利，而是受到卑鄙的贪念驱使。

en.t: My uncle was deliberately trying to force his daughter on me; when he raised the question of marriage, it was not for friendly mutual benefit between the two families, but because he was driven by a base greed.

units.source_text: 虽说我不爱堂妹，并不是厌恶她，但拒绝了婚事，我还是感觉愉快的。

en.t: Though I did not love my cousin, I did not hate her either; still, I felt pleased that I had refused the marriage.

units.source_text: 尽管被欺骗，无论怎么说都是这回事，

en.t: Even though I had been deceived, however one puts it, that much remained true,

units.source_text: 但若站在被欺骗的我的立场上，从没娶堂妹，

en.t: but from my own position as the one deceived, in not marrying my cousin,

units.source_text: 没任由他们摆布这一点来看，

en.t: and in not letting them have their way with me,

units.source_text: 多少坚持了自己的意志。

en.t: I had, to some extent, held to my own will.

units.source_text: 然而，这完全是不值一提的琐细之事，尤其是让你这个局外人评说的话，一定会说我这个人冥顽不灵吧。

en.t: Yet this was altogether a trivial matter not worth mentioning; especially if I asked you, an outsider, to judge it, you would surely say I was absurdly obstinate.

units.source_text: 其他亲戚介入了我和叔叔之间的谈判。

en.t: Other relatives intervened in the negotiations between my uncle and me.

units.source_text: 对这些亲戚我也完全不信任，何止不信任，可以说是敌视的。

en.t: I had absolutely no trust in these relatives either; more than mistrust, it could be called hostility.

units.source_text: 我发觉叔叔欺骗我的同时，就认定其他亲戚也一定会加害于我。

en.t: As soon as I realized that my uncle had deceived me, I concluded that the other relatives too would certainly do me harm.

units.source_text: 我的逻辑是，就连父亲那么称赞的叔叔尚且如此，何况他们乎！

en.t: My reasoning was that if even the uncle whom my father had praised so highly was like this, then how much more so the others!
